name: EVSD Cannon
description:
Manufacturer: Behring
Item Type: Distortion Cannon
Size: 2

Disable ships without hurting their crew or cargo with the EVSD from Behring. This distortion cannon features much of the same industry-leading technology used in other Behring weapons, but is specifically designed to be mounted on the nose of an Aegis Vanguard.
